description: This file defines the HonoConnectionImpl class, a Java implementation managing AMQP connections using Vert.x and Proton to connect to an Eclipse Hono service endpoint. It handles connection lifecycle, link creation, reconnection logic, and event handling for the Hono messaging protocol.

classes.name: HonoConnectionImpl
classes.description: A Java class managing AMQP connections to an Eclipse Hono endpoint by utilizing Vert.x and Proton APIs. Features include connection management, link creation, automatic reconnection with backoff, event handling, and support for capabilities, timeouts, and lifecycle control.

classes.name: ConnectMethodConnectionHandler
classes.description: Inner class that wraps connection handlers to ensure they handle connection events and trigger additional actions during connection attempts.

methods.name: getVertx
methods.description: Returns the Vert.x instance used by this connection client.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing tracer for message tracing within the client.

methods.name: getTracer
methods.description: Retrieves the current tracer used for message tracing.

methods.name: addDisconnectListener
methods.description: Registers a disconnect listener to be notified on disconnection events.

methods.name: addReconnectListener
methods.description: Registers a reconnect listener to be notified on successful reconnections.

methods.name: executeOrRunOnContext
methods.description: Executes the given handler on the connection's vert.x context, or returns a failed future if not connected.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the client is currently connected to the server.

methods.name: checkConnected
methods.description: Internal method to verify if the connection is active, returning a Future.

methods.name: isConnected(final long)
methods.description: Checks connection status, waiting up to the specified timeout for reconnection attempts.

methods.name: supportsCapability
methods.description: Determines if the remote peer offers a specific capability.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an AMQP connection to the server, with optional client options.

methods.name: createSender
methods.description: Creates an AMQP sender link to a specified target address with given QoS and optional close hook.

methods.name: createReceiver
methods.description: Creates an AMQP receiver link for a source address, setting message handler, prefetch size, and auto-accept mode.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes the connection and cleans up resources, optionally with a callback.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the server, with an optional callback upon completion.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Performs the actual closing of the current connection, handling timeouts and cleanup.
